harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Used Ansible (control node2 → managed node1) to schedule /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log via an ansible.builtin.cron task. Had to fix a broken sshd (missing host keys, inactive service) on node1 and repair a corrupted inventory-maintenance script (leftover heredoc artifact, not executable) before the deployment could work end-to-end. Verified the cron entry, log output, and idempotent playbook re-runs. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on both node1 and node2 sequentially, confirming boot-id changes and full recovery of cron/ansible functionality after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2 to find ansible tooling on node2 (control node) and Ubuntu 24.04 on both
Diagnosed and fixed inactive sshd on node1 (missing host keys) via ssh-keygen -A and systemctl enable/restart ssh
Added cluster SSH pubkey and node2's ansible id_rsa.pub to node1's root authorized_keys
Verified passwordless root SSH from node2 to node1
Created /root/inventory-maintenance-ansible/inventory.ini and playbook.yml on node2 using ansible.builtin.cron (minute=15, hour=2, root user)
Ran ansible-playbook against node1; confirmed changed=1 on first run and changed=0 (idempotent) on rerun
Discovered /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance was corrupted (contained literal leftover setup/heredoc text, not executable) and repaired its content and permissions (0755, root:root)
Manually executed the script piped into the log file to confirm correct output format and log creation
Verified crontab -l on node1 shows the Ansible-managed cron line and cron.service active/enabled
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and health (cron active, crontab entry, log content) on node1 and node2
Restarted node1 via backgrounded 'sleep 1; reboot', confirmed connection loss then recovery, verified changed boot_id, and re-verified cron/log/ssh health
Re-ran the Ansible playbook post-node1-restart to confirm idempotent management still works
Restarted node2 (control node) the same way, confirmed changed boot_id, verified ansible tooling, ssh key, and playbook/inventory files survived
Re-ran the playbook from recovered node2 against recovered node1 and re-checked node1 cron/log state to prove full cluster health after both restarts

evidence.requirement: Ansible control node identified and cron scheduling implemented via Ansible
evidence.summary: node2 has ansible installed; inventory and cron playbook created and applied to node1

evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled daily at 02:15 running the maintenance command and appending to the log file
evidence.summary: crontab -l on node1 shows '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'; second playbook run is idempotent (changed=0)

evidence.requirement: Prerequisite fix: sshd was down on node1 (missing host keys), blocking Ansible management
evidence.summary: Diagnosed sshd exit-code failure due to missing host keys, generated keys, restarted ssh, confirmed passwordless root SSH from node2 to node1 works

evidence.requirement: Prerequisite fix: inventory-maintenance script was corrupted and non-executable
evidence.summary: Found leftover heredoc artifact content and 644 perms; rewrote script correctly with chmod 0755; manual execution produced correct log line

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline captured before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f9bf293d..., cron active, crontab entry, and log content prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect, then changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged immediately; subsequent command timed out (node down); later command returned new boot_id 56cb5f31...

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery of cron/log/ssh and Ansible manageability
evidence.summary: cron active, crontab entry intact, log content preserved, SSH from node2 working, and Ansible playbook rerun idempotent (ok=2, changed=0)

evidence.requirement: node2 (control node) restart: healthy baseline captured before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 489b0bb4..., confirmed ansible tooling and playbook files present prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect, then changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged immediately; subsequent command timed out; later command returned new boot_id 87cb91fa...

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: post-restart recovery of Ansible tooling/files and continued cluster management capability
evidence.summary: ansible binary functional, inventory/playbook files and SSH key intact; playbook rerun against node1 succeeded idempotently; node1 cron/log state confirmed healthy post both restarts
